claim_ledger.claim: ZA Wc2 most probably ends with numeral2 rather than erased MI
assumptions: Published autopsies reliable; physical recount not independently performed
claim_ledger.novelty: Perna1994 proposal, newly corroborated by Anastasiadou2025; not a discovery here

claim_ledger.claim: A-TI-KA is a plausible person-related designation in Linear A
assumptions: Boundary after KA on ZA Wc2
claim_ledger.strongest_counterargument: Entire A-TI-KA-A-DU-KO may be one expression; exact spelling across scripts does not ensure same meaning or referent

claim_ledger.claim: A-DU identifies an action on ZA Wc2
claim_ledger.strongest_counterargument: Toponym, institution, account scope, or part of a longer expression remains compatible

claim_ledger.claim: The same seal independently identifies A-TI-KA's participant role
claim_ledger.strongest_counterargument: Seal names no verified written actor; inward and outward transfers both fit physical association

claim_ledger.claim: Each impression universally equals one written commodity unit on all counted roundels
claim_ledger.status: fails under reported Malia counts and positive additive fraction interpretation
claim_ledger.strongest_counterargument: Malia missing or miscounted impressions; differences of ration/commodity units; not a refutation of local animal-count equality

assumptions: Independently established recipient identity would be required
claim_ledger.strongest_counterargument: No named entity in the selected group has an independently recognizable transfer role; presence of a numeral may mark another document subtype

claim_ledger.claim: A participant-action construction is established on ZA Wc2
claim_ledger.strongest_counterargument: Segmentation, verbal meaning, commodity status, and directed participant identity remain partly or wholly interdependent
